supersedes: KOD-LEARNER-v1 (research/LEARNER_v1/ADDENDUM_1.md): its claim is withdrawn before any outcome existed, for the defects listed there; its two sealed forecasts stay in paper/learner.jsonl and keep verifying
ledger: paper/learner_v2.jsonl, hash-chained and timestamped like the other ledgers, append-only

skill_kinds.RELATIVE: graded against the set's own twins: BEATS_TWINS_<k>, LOSES_TO_TWINS_<k> (the dilution family's call), WITH_FLOW_RUNUP and REVERSAL_POST20 (IDX_INDEX)
skill_kinds.MECHANISM: the stated catalyst happens: MECH_13DA_UP_60 (SEC13D_V2), MECH_SECOND_BUY_20 (FORM4_SHARP)
skill_kinds.TRIANGULATED: the mechanism happened AND the stock beat its twins over the window that contains it

statements.absolute: GAIN0_<k>, FADE10_<k>, RUN30_<k>: a rising market makes them true, so they are forecast with the anchor alone, never learned and never scored as skill
statements.base_prior: the family's frozen prior for the statement; 0.5 where the family protocol says 'running'; TRIANGULATED the product of its two components'

anchor.what: a climatology twin of the learner, per family and statement: the same logistic fit, the same intercept prior and the same row weights, with an intercept only (offset logit(base prior)). It learns how often each statement comes true; it knows nothing about any set.
anchor.why: the comparator of LEARNER_v1 was the sealed prior, often a 0.5 placeholder: a learner that only learned base rates would have beaten it without telling any two sets apart

model.kind: one penalised logistic model per skill kind, fitted as logit p = logit(base prior) + intercept[statement or history source] + (x - training centre[statement]) . slope[statement], the training centre being the weighted mean of the statement's training rows (else the kind's)
model.forecast: raw = sigmoid(logit(anchor) + (x - live centre[statement]) . slope[statement]), the live centre being the mean features of every live set of that family and statement sealed by the forecast time, resolved or not (features only, no outcome): the learner moves the anchor by the set's own features and nothing else, its average move over the live population is zero by construction, and a shift between history and the live sets cannot move every forecast the same way. The only possible gain is discrimination
model.sharing: RELATIVE statements share one slope vector plus a deviation each (REVERSAL_POST20, true when the stock goes against the call, has its own slopes only); MECHANISM and TRIANGULATED statements have their own slopes
model.feature_rules: only fields sealed in the set (and, for repeat/corroborate/conflict, the sets before it in the ledger). Price features signed by the call's direction: s_ret1 = d x ret1 / 0.10, s_ret5 = d x ret5 / 0.20, s_ret20 = d x ret20 / 0.30, s_dd60 = d x dd60 / 0.30 (clipped to -3..3), s_cpos = d x (cpos - 0.5) x 2; log_volr = ln volr (-3..3); log_adv = log10(20-session median traded value in USD) - 6.5 (-3..3; IDX converted at 16,000 IDR per USD); rule flags as 0/1; log_mv = log10(market value USD) - 9; log_value = log10(purchase USD) - 5; owners = (n - 1) / 4 capped at 1; lag = days / 30 capped at 1; pct_inc = holdings increase / 5 capped at 1; stake = largest cover-page percent / 20 capped at 2; intent_words = Item 4 intent words / 5 capped at 1; repeat, corroborate and conflict = distinct earlier events on the same market and ticker with a signal session in the 90 calendar days up to the set's own (same source group; another group with the same direction; the opposite direction), each / 3 capped at 1; a field the family does not record is 0
model.fit: Newton (IRLS) from zero, at most 50 iterations, tolerance 1e-10; Laplace covariance (inverse Hessian) at the maximum a posteriori
model.dedupe: a row's weight is 1 / the number of sets of the same underlying event (a child family's set and its parent's) with the same statement

warm_start.events: 5,587: 1,065 original 13D filings (KILL_TEST_2020_2023), 2,964 insider purchases (US_INSIDER_BUY stage 1), 1,558 Item 3.02 8-Ks (US_8K_ITEMS stage 1); signal dates 2020-07-02..2023-11-28; the sealed US holdout (2024 onward) is never read
warm_start.not_covered: MECH_13DA_UP_60 and SEC13D_V2's TRIANGULATED start from live outcomes only: before December 2024 a Schedule 13D amendment has no structured cover page, so a stake increase in 2020-2023 cannot be read reliably
warm_start.own_intercepts: every history source has its own intercept, so history's base rates (survivor-only prices, controls' mean instead of the twins' median) never reach the live anchor; history informs slopes only
warm_start.weight: each kind's history rows share a total weight of 300: history counts as much as 300 live outcomes, so the live record outweighs it within about a year

earned_confidence.forward_pairs: a sealed forecast and one of its skill statements whose outcome resolved after the forecast was made, weighted as the training rows
earned_confidence.observations: one per (signal session, resolving window, resolution time): the mean of Brier(anchor) - Brier(raw) over its pairs, an underlying event weighted once per statement inside the observation, in the order they resolved; an observation never changes once it exists (a pair resolved later forms a new one)
earned_confidence.bound: the running maximum, from t_min observations on, of the lower edge of the asymptotic confidence sequence for the mean observation (Waudby-Smith, Arbour, Sinha, Kennedy and Ramdas, 'Time-uniform central limit theory and asymptotic confidence sequences'), two-sided level delta, rho tuned for t_star. The sequence is valid at every number of observations at once, so checking it daily does not raise the chance that luck clears zero, and its running intersection is itself a confidence sequence: proven skill stays proven while the bound's own noise wanders
earned_confidence.alpha: 0 below t_min observations; otherwise skill_lower = bound / mean anchor Brier and recent = mean of the last `recent` observations / mean anchor Brier; alpha = 0 if either is <= 0, else clip(min(skill_lower, recent) / skill_full, 0, 1). Confidence is lost through the recent record, which follows the edge as it decays

calls.rule: BACK when the learner's move from the anchor (logit) is at least margin and the move minus z posterior sd is above 0; AVOID the mirror. A call is LIVE when alpha x the move also clears the margin; otherwise it is a SHADOW call: sealed and scored, not published
calls.scored: hit rate against the anchor's rate on the same pairs, with a Wilson interval; the paired excess return of the matching window; each BACK on a relative statement classified as earned_catalyst_came, beat_twins_no_catalyst, beat_twins (no mechanism to check), rose_with_market_but_lost_to_twins (a gain the market carried: a miss), or miss

timing: learner2-forecast runs after the catalyst-seal steps and before each set's entry cutoff; one forecast per set; a set past its cutoff is never forecast

claim.statistic: per signal session, the weighted mean of Brier(anchor) - Brier(raw) over every forward-scored skill pair; one-sided t against 0 across sessions
claim.why_raw: the raw forecast is the learner's own sealed opinion; scoring it tests whether the learning works, whatever the gate allows it to publish
claim.eligible: t >= that look's t_min and one-sided p < 0.05 with a positive mean: ELIGIBLE FOR OWNER REVIEW
claim.futility: from the 240 look, a mean at or below 0 is FAIL (futility): the learner tells sets apart no better than base rates

verify: paper-verify: the chain; one forecast per set, bound to the sealed set by its record hash and made before its cutoff; the protocol and warm-start hashes; and every anchor, raw and published value, every call and every alpha reproduced within 1e-6 by retraining on the resolutions dated before the forecast (numbers, not a hash of weights, so a different floating-point library cannot raise a false alarm, and a learner that saw a later outcome cannot pass)
never: change a family rule, prior, twin draw, resolution or ledger line
feed back into any family's sealing (the families stay frozen; the learner sits beside them)
use an outcome resolved after its forecast, or a price after the signal session
